heading: Projects I've delivered
sub: Pick a project — the diagram shows how it actually works, not just what it used.

projects.title: AI-Powered AEM Sites ADLC
projects.description: A multi-agent framework that automates the end-to-end AEM Sites development lifecycle using specialized AI agents and reusable AEM Markdown skills — from architecture design through code generation, testing, and deployment.
projects.diagramCaption: Hover or tap an agent to see what it actually does.
points: Created specialized AI agents using Markdown skills for architecture, design, and code generation.
Automated the creation of AEM components, dialogs, HTL, OSGi configurations, and Content Fragments.
Built an approval-driven workflow for generating and reviewing architectural designs before code is written.
Automated code validation, Git commits, PR creation, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
Validated end-to-end workflows using Claude CLI and VS Code to minimize manual developer effort.

projects.title: Enterprise AEM Support Automation
projects.description: An enterprise support platform integrating Jira/ServiceNow, Claude Agent SDK, and Adobe MCP servers to autonomously diagnose, debug, and resolve L1/L2 AEM issues — with a risk engine that keeps production changes human-approved.
projects.diagramCaption: Hover or tap a step to see what actually happens at each stage.
points: Built webhook pipelines that process tickets, extract context, and trigger diagnostics automatically.
Integrated Adobe MCP servers for live environment access — log and JCR analysis grounded in real evidence.
Developed a FastAPI risk-classification engine requiring HITL approval for production changes.
Implemented structured audit trails and execution logging across Python microservices.
Deployed PostgreSQL-backed microservices on AWS EC2 for persistent ticket state and log storage.

projects.title: Global Marketing Enhancements
projects.description: An enterprise marketing platform on Headless AEM and Angular SPA, delivering healthcare content across multiple regions and digital channels from one shared content model.
projects.diagramCaption: Hover or tap a node to see what actually happens at each stage.
points: Implemented Headless AEM with Angular SPA architecture end to end.
Designed templates, components, Sling Models, Servlets, and OSGi services; used MSM for multilingual content.
Built Auto-Suggestion Search using AEM Search APIs.
Integrated Adobe Analytics, CJA Analytics, and Marketo for marketing insight.
Managed Dispatcher configuration and SEO (sitemap/robots.txt); coordinated with AMS and Release teams.
Achieved 50%+ JUnit code coverage.

projects.title: AEM 6.5 → AEMaaCS Migration
projects.description: Migrated enterprise websites from AEM 6.5 On-Premise to AEM as a Cloud Service — cloud compliance, performance improvement, and architecture modernization, without a broken release.
projects.diagramCaption: Hover or tap a step to see what actually happens at each stage.
points: Performed requirement analysis, sprint planning, and story estimation.
Executed BPA and resolved every critical cloud-compatibility issue ahead of migration.
Refactored WCMUsePojo classes to Sling Models; migrated static and editable templates.
Ran content migration using the CTT tool and Groovy scripts; configured environment-specific run modes.
Set up and maintained Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines with 50%+ JUnit coverage.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform Development
projects.description: A full e-commerce platform for Golf Pride on an AEM Hybrid SPA, supporting the complete purchase lifecycle end to end.
projects.diagramCaption: Hover or tap a step to see what actually happens at each stage.
points: Implemented Cart, Payment, Shipping, Inventory Management, and Order Confirmation modules.
Integrated Adobe Analytics for customer tracking across the purchase journey.
Built custom AEM components with robust dialog validations for reusability and UI integrity.
Used Query Builder and Page Manager APIs; maintained 50%+ JUnit coverage.
